A wanderer's tale

Echoesof the Forgotten Kingdom

A sealed gate. Three lost fragments. A kingdom that walked out of the world and left the door ajar for someone patient enough to find the keys.

Mouse = look · WASD = walk — the cursor is captured when you begin, press Esc to release it
Best played with a mouse and headphones · Everything you see and hear is generated in your browser

The Echo Gate is open

Elvareth Remembers

The seal sinks away and the Heartstone sings as one. Beyond the arch there is no darkness — only a green morning, and the sound of ten thousand voices finishing a sentence they began an age ago.

Someone is waiting on the far side. They kept counting.
